newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss post office,Winterthur form venture.
newsitem.headline: Swiss post office,Winterthur form venture.

text.p: Switzerland's state postal authority and Winterthur Insurance Co said they formed a cooperative venture to offer life insurance products at postal counters.
The post authority is taking responsibility for sales and marketing and will make its traditional payment channels, such as its postal bank, available for the venture, the two said in statement.
Winterthur will take responsibility for product forms, contract handling, portfolio and investment management.
The plan calls for insurance product sales to begin in 1998.

PTT Post, which already offers payment cards, automatic tellers and federal savings bonds, last week announced it would start selling investment fund products at postal counters in a venture with Swiss Bank Corp SBC.
